text: Table 2 reports that in the Passage+Snippet+Argument condition at the first judgment, judges were 72.8% correct, 20.4% incorrect and 6.8% abstaining (ratio 3.6) under simple incentives, and 60.6% correct, 13.3% incorrect and 26.1% abstaining (ratio 4.5) under encourage-abstain; after counter-arguments with simple incentives they were 72.2% correct and 20.7% incorrect.
